purpose: Preserve a reference to the legacy furniture AI repository until it is safe and useful to integrate.
reason_for_isolation: Git history contains a previously exposed Alibaba credential.
The repository contains duplicated backend/application structures.
Some training and catalog paths are placeholders or unverified prototypes.
activation_requirements: Revoke or rotate the exposed credential and review its usage logs.
Clean the contaminated Git history and invalidate old clones where practical.
Run secret scanning and dependency/security checks.
Separate real implementations from mock, placeholder, and demo code.
Confirm licenses for code, datasets, models, images, and catalog records.
Import only reviewed components through a new pull request.
handling_policy: Do not execute, import, clone automatically, or expose this repository through the unified runtime until every activation requirement is completed.
